entries.ffeda8d525a0ce99: For automotive refinishing paints, the company plans to focus on the maintenance field; for architectural paints, it plans to focus on maintenance while also addressing new construction; and for industrial paints, it plans to promote sales activities with individual responses to users. The company plans to strengthen its response to environmental and chemical-substance regulations, focus on developing new products and systems centered on environmentally compliant products that meet regulations, and work to improve the product strength of water-based paints. It states that, as domestic paint demand stagnates, it will expand market share through strengthened product development capability and the creation of new markets.
